# Str

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Language Features](Language-Features) · [Types](Language-Features-Types)

</div>


```blitzbasic
Str(value)
Str:String(value)
```

## Description

Converts a number to a text. This also happens by itself when a number is joined to a text with `+`, but writing it out makes clear what the program does.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
n = 12
Print "n = " + Str(n)
Print Str(2.5) + "!"
```

```text
n = 12
2.5!
```
